t: Nix, Pipulate, and the Quest for Computational Sovereignty
s: This article chronicles a personal journey toward durable, future-proof computing, culminating in Nix as the foundation for computational sovereignty. It introduces Pipulate, a framework built on Nix, designed to safely harness AI within resilient, user-controlled environments by leveraging Unix's ephemeral 'soap-bubble' model for AI safety.
sub: Nix as the ultimate solution for deterministic, cross-platform interoperability and system reproduction
Evolution from QEMU-based Levinux and mutable LXD containers to Nix for reliable system builds
Unix's 'soap-bubble' statelessness as a critical safeguard against AI incubation and a mechanism for AI safety
Pipulate framework for creating user-controlled, durable AI environments using a simple LPvg + HTMX stack
Intentional state management in Pipulate (`pip.set`) to provide memory to 'amnesiac' AIs while retaining human control
